s: dantyasakAraH । sa tu vyaYjanadvAtriMSavarRaH । asyoccAraRasTAnaM dantaH । iti vyAkaraRam ॥ (taTAca SikzAyAm । 17 । “syurmUrdDanyA fwurazA dantyA xtulasAH smftAH ॥”) tatsvarUpaM yaTA, -- “sakAraM SfRu cArvvaNgi SaktivIjaM parAtparam । kowividyullatAkAraM kuRqalItrayasaMyutam ॥ paYcadevamayaM devi paYcaprARAtmakaM sadA । rajaHsattvatamoyuktaM tribindusahitaM sadA ॥” iti kAmaDenutantram ॥ * ॥ asya leKanaprakAro yaTA, -- “kuYcitA vAmato dakzagatA ca gokftilvaDaH । punarUrdDvagatA tAsu vahnicandradivAkarAH । mAtrA BavAnI vijYeyA DyAnamasya pracakzyate ॥” asya DyAnAdi । “SuklAmbarAM SuklavarRAM dviBujAM raktalocanAm । SvetacandanaliptANgIM muktAhAropaSoBitAm ॥ ganDarvvagIyamAnAYca sadAnandamayIM parAm । azwasidDipradAM nityAM BaktAnandavivardDinIm ॥ evaM DyAtvA sakArantu tanmantraM daSaDA japet ॥ triSakti sahitaM varRaM AtmAditattvasaMyutam । praRamya satataM devi hfdi BAvaya sundari ॥” iti varRodDAratantram ॥ * ॥ tatparyyAyaH “so haMsaH suyaSA vizRurBfgvISaScandrasaMjYakaH । jagadvIjaM SaktinAmA so'haM veSavatI BfguH ॥ prakftirISvaraH SudDaH praBA SvetA kulojjvalaH । dakzapAdo'mftaM brAhmI paramAtmA paro'kzaraH ॥ surUpA ca guReSo gOH kalakaRWo vfkodarI । prARAdyASca purAdevI lakzmIH somo hiraRyapUH । durgottAriRi sammohAjjIvo mUrttirmanoharaH ॥” iti tantram ॥
[m] vya, SoBanArTaH । samArTaH । saNgatArTaH । prakfzwArTaH । iti medinI ॥ upasargaviSezaH । asyArTAH yaTA । sam prakarzASlezanErantaryyOcityABimuKyezu । iti mugDaboDawIkAyAM durgAdAsaH ॥

puM, ISvaraH । sarpaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ pakzI । ityekzAkarakozaH ॥ vizRuH । yaTA । saH syAdvizRO hare sarpe । iti BaratEkArTasaMgrahaH ॥ pUrvyoktaparAmarSakaH । se iti BAzA । tacCabdasya praTamEkavacananizpannaH । yaTA BawwiH । 1 । 2 । “sO'DyEzwa vedAMstridaSAnayazwa pitFnapArIt samamaMsta banDUn ॥” samAsapUrvapadatve sahArTaH । yaTA । samAtfkaH । kvacit samAnArTaSca । yaTA । sarUpaH । iti vyAkaraRam ॥

m: 1. स the last of the three sibilants (it belongs to the dental class and in sound corresponds to s in sin).
2. स (in prosody) an anapest (˘ ˘ ¯)
3. स (in music) an abbreviated term for षड्-ज (see p. 1109, col. 2).
4. स m. (only L.) a snake
air, wind
a bird
N. of Viṣṇu or Śiva
स n. knowledge
meditation
a carriage road
a fence.
5. स mfn. (fr. √ सन्) procuring, bestowing (only ifc.; cf. पलु-ष and प्रिय-स).

6. स the actual base for the nom. case of the 3rd pers. pron. तद्, q.v. (occurring only in the nom. sg. mf. [स or सस्, सा], and in the Ved. loc. [सस्मिन्, RV. i, 152, 6; i, 174, 4; x, 95, 11]; the final स् of the nom. m. is dropped before all consonants [except before प् in RV. v, 2, 4, and before त् in RV. viii, 33, 16] and appears only at the end of a sentence in the form of Visarga; स occasionally blends with another vowel [as in सईषः]; and it is often for emphasis connected with another pron. as with अहम्, त्वम्, एष, अयम् &c. [e.g. सो ऽहम्, स त्वम्, ‘I (or thou) that very person’; cf. under तद्, p. 434], the verb then following in the 1st and 2nd pers. even if अहम् or त्वम् be omitted [e.g. स त्वा पृच्छामि ‘I that very person ask you’, BṛĀrUp.; स वै नो ब्रूहि ‘do thou tell us’, ŚBr.]; similarly, to denote emphasis, with भवान् [e.g. स भवान् विजयाय प्रतिष्ठताम्, ‘let your Highness set out for victory’, Śak.]; it sometimes [and frequently in the Brāhmaṇas] stands as the first word of a sentence preceding a rel. pronoun or adv. such as य, यद्, यदि, यथा, चेद्; in this position स may be used pleonastically or as a kind of ind., even where another gender or number is required [e.g. स यदि स्थावरा आपो भनन्ति, ‘if those waters are stagnant’, ŚBr.]; in the Sāṃkhya स, like एष, क, and य, is used to denote Puruṣa, ‘the Universal Soul’), RV. &c. &c.
स [cf. Zd. hō, hā; Gk. ὁ, ἡ.]

7. स ind. (connected with सह, सम्, सम, and occasionally in BhP. standing for सह with instr.) an inseparable prefix expressing ‘junction’, ‘conjunction’, ‘possession’ (as opp. to अ priv.), ‘similarity’, ‘equality’

(and when compounded with nouns to form adjectives and adverbs it may be translated by ‘with’, ‘together or along with’, ‘accompanied by’, ‘added to’, ‘having’, ‘possessing’, ‘containing’, ‘having the same’ [cf. स-कोप, साग्नि, स-भाय, स-द्रोण, स-धर्मन्, स-वर्ण]; or it may = ‘ly’, as in स-कोपम्, ‘angrily’, सोपधि, ‘fraudulently’), RV.; &c.
स [cf. Gk. ἁ in ἁπλοῦς; Lat. sim in simplex; sem in semel, semper Eng. same.]
सं (in comp.) = 2. सम्, q.v.

a: स — ind. A prefix substituted for सह or सम्, सम, तुल्य, or सदृश and एक or समान, and compounded with nouns to form adjectives and adverbs in the sense of (a) with, together with, along with, accompanied by, having, possessed of; सपुत्र, सभार्य, सतृष्ण, सधन, सरोषं, सकोपं, सहरि &c.; (b) similar, like; सधर्मन् ‘of a similar nature’; so सजाति, सवर्ण; (c) same; सोदर, सपक्ष, सपिंड, सनाभि &c. --m. 1 A snake. --2 Air, wind. --3 A bird. --4 short name for the musical note षड्ज q. v. --5 N. of Śiva. --6 Of Viṣṇu. --7 (In prosody) A foot consisting of two short syllables followed by a long one. --सा The goddess Lakṣmī. --सं 1 Knowledge. --2 Meditation. --3 A carriage-road. --4 A fence, an enclosure.
